summary: Build breach triage, notification, and reporting skills in 5 days. Train your team for defensible response and compliance-ready action.
lede: Data breach response turns suspected incidents into documented decisions about scope, containment, evidence and notification. For professionals in incident handling, privacy, security or governance, the course covers incident classification, evidence preservation, notification threshold assessment, regulator-facing message drafting, and coordination of containment and recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support incident handling, privacy compliance, or governance and need to manage breach response and notification with more structure and confidence.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of information security, privacy, or compliance processes; familiarity with incident handling terminology; and experience reviewing policies, logs, or case notes. No coding is required. Participants should be ready to work with breach scenarios, notification templates, and incident evidence records at an intermediate operational level.
